import json
def transform(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    # divider color = color forming full rows
    div=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    # find shape: non-divider colors, pick the one whose cells form non-2x2
    colors=set(x for r in g for x in r)-{0,div}
    shape_color=None
    for c in colors:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==c]
        rs=[i for i,_ in cells]; cs=[j for _,j in cells]
        bh=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; bw=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
        if len(cells)!=bh*bw or bh!=2 or bw!=2:
            shape_color=c; r0,c0=min(rs),min(cs); r1,c1=max(rs),max(cs)
    pat=[[1 if g[r0+i][c0+j]==shape_color else 0 for j in range(c1-c0+1)] for i in range(r1-r0+1)]
    # divider row indices
    div_rows=[i for i in range(h) if all(g[i][j]==div for j in range(w))]
    div_cols=[j for j in range(w) if all(g[i][j]==div for i in range(h))]
    # band starts
    def starts(dl,n):
        s=[];prev=-1
        for i in sorted(dl):
            s.append((prev+1,i)); prev=i
        s.append((prev+1,n))
        return [a for a,b in s]
    rbs=starts(div_rows,h); cbs=starts(div_cols,w)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for rb in rbs:
        # band color: non-zero non-div color in this band
        bc=None
        for i in range(rb,rb+4):
            for j in range(w):
                if g[i][j] not in (0,div): bc=g[i][j]; break
            if bc: break
        for cb in cbs:
            for i in range(len(pat)):
                for j in range(len(pat[0])):
                    if pat[i][j]:
                        out[rb+i][cb+j]=bc
    return out
